name: 2027 Option 1 — Maximum scored coverage
assumptions: Per-layer mixed-integer optimisation with original audience eligibility, known full-course durations and 4/8/24/4-hour budgets. Coverage only, then fewer hours and fewer resources. No quality weighting. Conditional optima, not a global workforce optimum. Internal learner time is separately budgeted: 3h foundation, 6h Practitioner, 12h technical Expert, 8h governance Expert, 6h leadership and 4h per applicable specialty. No scored coverage credit for internal proposals. Planning duration corrections: TR-158 1h30 means 1.5h; TR-155 official four-module path totals 9h26m (566/60 hours), superseding the catalogue 8h metadata for planning only. TR-159 combines several lab collections and has no total duration, so exclude from auto-selection until scoped. These do not alter assessment scores. Explicit minute durations for INT-271, INT-275, INT-276, INT-340, INT-452, INT-476 and INT-1473 are retained using overrides because the app parser currently treats their parenthesised lecture counts as ambiguous; no content-based score changes. Global curriculum: nationally framed guidance is not assigned as common training. TR-125, TR-128 and TR-129 are excluded; globally applicable technical frameworks are retained. Jurisdiction-specific obligations belong in relevant local-role supplements, with separate time allowances.

all.title: B1 Bank AI essentials and safe-use check
all.owner: AI adoption lead with IDP and each domain head
all.outcomes: Map two domain use cases and how individual work changes; explain the actual approved enterprise-agent architecture, connector permissions, data boundaries and stop/escalation controls; handle a planted error, unsafe request and spoofed message. Proposed 1h briefing, 1h coached case, 1h assessment and feedback.

practitioner.title: B2/B3 Supervision, Skill and evaluation practicum
practitioner.outcomes: Two 2h labs plus 2h observed sign-off: least privilege, inspect independent traces, reject injected or incorrect output, stop/revoke/rollback, hand over, document a Skill with owner and lifecycle, run a small known-answer eval set. Authorisation is per action class; reassess after material changes.

technical.title: B3/B5 Build, evaluate and secure one agent
technical.owner: AI engineering lead and independent security assessor
technical.outcomes: 8h scoped build/evaluation project, 2h attack and recovery test, 2h independent challenge and assessor calibration. Include versioned cases, human-labelled judge checks, external enforcement, safe-stop evidence, cost/drift controls and ownership. Completion does not authorise every agent design. Maintain an assigned AI threat-source watch and brief changes that affect the role.

governance.title: B4-GRC/B5 Evidence-based AI risk and assurance case
governance.owner: AI risk lead with BISO and assurance
governance.outcomes: Prepare one inventory/risk/vendor dossier and action-class policy, challenge the claimed controls using test evidence, calibrate reviewer decisions and record residual risk and accountability. Maintain an assigned AI threat-source watch and brief changes that affect the role.

leadership.title: B6 Leadership decision exercise and quarterly forums
leadership.outcomes: 2h benchmark and autonomy decision exercise plus four 1h forums on value, risk, human capacity, junior skill retention and adoption. No technical or operational authority follows from attendance. Maintain an assigned AI threat-source watch and brief changes that affect the role.

cdc.title: Agent incident response drill
cdc.outcomes: Suspend an agent, preserve independent logs, revoke access, recover safely and work manually.

forensics.title: Agent evidence reconstruction exercise
forensics.outcomes: Reconstruct an agent trajectory from independent evidence, preserve chain of custody and distinguish generated summaries from original artefacts.

idp.title: DLP and classification control case
idp.outcomes: Assess agent data flows, confidential-data leakage and classification errors; N13 only for nominated AI risk assessors.

biso.title: Agent assurance evidence challenge
biso.outcomes: Test controls at the enforcement point and validate the AI used to generate assurance evidence.

testing.title: Contained agent testing exercise
testing.outcomes: Test own agents in an isolated sandbox; enforce scope and stop from outside the model, reproduce findings and manage collateral discoveries.

redteam.title: Specialist agent red-team validation
redteam.outcomes: Run an authorised multi-step attack and validate the full trajectory, boundaries and reproducible evidence.

exposure.title: Agent and connector inventory exercise
exposure.outcomes: Discover MCP/Skills, record sponsor/version/permissions, verify content hashes and scan changes.

harness.title: Code-analysis harness validation
harness.outcomes: Evaluate on a known-vulnerability corpus; include patched/unpatched tests, repeatability, deduplication and cost limits.

architecture.title: Agent control-plane design review
architecture.outcomes: Specify action tiers, external authorisation, immutable evidence, stop levers, tenancy and usable oversight.

iam.title: Agent joiner mover leaver and revocation drill
iam.outcomes: Register sponsor and purpose, scope delegation, recertify access and verify session revocation.

iam-expert.title: Agent identity integration and break-glass test
iam-expert.outcomes: Test IGA/PAM/SIEM integration, delegated identity, JIT grants, expiry and independently verified revocation.

cio.title: Vendor decision and adoption review
cio.outcomes: Compare vendor claims against a common bank test set and sign a risk/value adoption decision; no invented role extra.

name: 2027 Option 4 — Quality core and in-house capability

all.title: IH-01 · What our people are doing with AI
all.owner: Cyber AI adoption lead + champions from all six functions
all.outcomes: 10m orientation; 35m two colleague-led case demonstrations including a failure and its correction; 15m an emerging or restricted-pilot demonstration; 15m domain application; 15m knowledge check and reflection. Use a short case gallery to represent all six functions without six separate lectures. Evidence: N1.1: explain one own-domain and one neighbouring-domain use case, including limitations. N1.2: distinguish production, restricted pilot and horizon examples. N1.3: propose two or three changes to own work and identify retained human accountability.

all.title: IH-02 · Our approved tools, agent architecture and boundaries
all.owner: AI platform owner + IAM + IDP + security architecture
all.outcomes: 25m model, modality and agent walkthrough; 25m approved platforms, data flow and connector permissions; 20m approval, logs and stop controls; 20m access/data-boundary decisions. Use one real approved architecture with a simplified diagram. Evidence: Label model, harness, tools and controls; select the permitted platform for a data class; distinguish available access from a pilot; locate the correct approval, stop and escalation route.

all.title: IH-03 · Safe use in my job — coached case and Gate 1
all.outcomes: 15m coached case; 30m individual safe-use scenario; 15m feedback. Use approved or synthetic data and a task representative of the learner’s function. Evidence: Reject an unsafe data/tool choice, detect a planted unsupported claim or injection, verify the output and record accountability. Safety-critical decisions must pass.

practitioner.title: IH-04 · Supervise and recover an agent on our platform
practitioner.owner: Domain operations owner + AI platform team
practitioner.outcomes: 30m workflow and permissions; 60m trace-review and planted-error lab; 30m stop, revoke, rollback and manual-fallback exercise. Evidence: Delegate within an approved action class, inspect permissions and changes, identify planted failures, stop/revoke safely and produce an accountable handover.

practitioner.title: IH-05 · Create, own and retire a shared Skill
practitioner.owner: Domain automation champion + Skill-library owner + IAM
practitioner.outcomes: 30m worked example and third-party vetting; 60m create a focused Skill and safe connector specification; 30m peer review, ownership, monthly review and deprecation. Evidence: Submit a trigger, steps, expected output, failure modes and tests; name an owner and review/deprecation rule; justify connector permissions and provenance.

practitioner.title: IH-06 · Domain test cases and release checks
practitioner.outcomes: 30m independent answers and known faults; 60m build and run five representative cases with pass/fail checks; 30m simulate a model/Skill change and submit results to the domain evaluation process. Evidence: Versioned cases, known faults and acceptance checks; rerun record; contribution to the shared domain evidence store.

practitioner.title: IH-07 · Agent-supervisor observed sign-off
practitioner.outcomes: 75m observed task with injected faults and a connector change; 30m independent challenge; 15m feedback and scope-of-authority record. Evidence: Pass each safety-critical action and justify an evidence-based release decision. Record permitted action classes and any remediation.

technical.title: IH-08T · Workflow and supervision design studio
technical.owner: Process owner + technical lead + operational supervisor
technical.outcomes: 45m map current work; 60m redesign tasks and approval points; 45m review evaluation evidence and supervision load; 30m agree measures and ownership. Evidence: An approved before/after workflow, human/agent task split, supervision ratio hypothesis, autonomy limits supported by evaluation, value baseline, owner and refresh plan.

technical.title: IH-09T · Build, evaluate and secure a scoped agent
technical.owner: AI engineering + AppSec + domain evaluation lead
technical.outcomes: 2h configure an existing approved scaffold; 2h tests and human-label calibration; 2h attack, recovery and production-monitoring rehearsal; 1h evidence dossier. Reuse one project across the pathway. Evidence: Versioned implementation and test cases, human-checked judge results, working controls, attack/recovery trace, monitoring and ownership record.

technical.title: IH-10T · Independent technical challenge
technical.outcomes: 75m reproduce an unseen failure and recovery; 30m design/evidence challenge; 15m feedback and permitted-scope record. Evidence: Reproducible test evidence and pass on all critical controls within the authorised action class.

governance.title: IH-08G · Workflow, supervision and accountability studio
governance.outcomes: 30m current workflow; 45m autonomy/approval design; 30m value and oversight measures; 15m ownership agreement. Evidence: An approved before/after workflow, human/agent task split, supervision ratio hypothesis, autonomy limits supported by evaluation, value baseline, owner and refresh plan.

governance.title: IH-09G · Bank AI-risk and assurance evidence case
governance.owner: AI risk lead + assurance lead + domain evaluator
governance.outcomes: 1h inventory and risk scenario; 1h control/vendor dossier; 1h independent-test and judge-evidence review; 1h risk decision and escalation. Map local obligations only for the role and jurisdictions concerned. Evidence: Traceable risk decision, control evidence, vendor challenge, human-labelled evaluation sample and named residual-risk owner.

governance.title: IH-10G · Independent governance challenge
governance.outcomes: 75m evidence challenge; 30m reviewer calibration; 15m feedback and decision-rights record. Evidence: Defend the risk decision with test evidence, recognise weak automated evaluation and specify unresolved conditions.

leadership.title: IH-08L · Operating-model and tool-selection decision studio
leadership.owner: CIO strategy lead + process owners + AI risk lead
leadership.outcomes: 30m workflow/value baseline; 45m vendor and autonomy decision; 30m supervision capacity and junior-skill retention; 15m ownership and next evidence request. Evidence: An approved before/after workflow, human/agent task split, supervision ratio hypothesis, autonomy limits supported by evaluation, value baseline, owner and refresh plan. Challenge at least one vendor claim and one weak evaluation result.

leadership.title: IH-09L · Quarterly evidence and adoption forums
leadership.outcomes: Four 1h forums: baseline and test-set quality; autonomy and judge validation; production drift/value; refresh and accountability. Include a short coached lesson before the decision. Evidence: Four decision records connecting evaluation results to adoption, supervision capacity, permissions and investment.
